limitations: Expanded development set; the prior unseen-video results remain frozen.
Hawkins is now training data; Nutcharut selects models and thresholds.
Editorial labels on these two sources are coarse AI source-review preferences, not physical-stop truth.
Refit uses all four development matches; only Allen is a future independent test.
Benchmarks decode clip records; generated MP4s still require rendering and visual review.
Partial-source cached features cover reviewed windows and context; unreviewed contact predictions are ignored.
Training footage is in-sample; dev footage selects the model and thresholds.
